name: codex-resumed-session
description: A Codex CLI session resumed from an earlier conversation, so its first recorded turn measures a warm window rather than a cold startup prefix. The adapter must refuse to claim an anchor rather than mislabel that turn as a measurement: nothing reconciles, and the fixed total and the unaccounted remainder are both reported as unknown rather than as a number.
title: fixture-codex-resumed

expect.notes: The first recorded turn reports last_token_usage 21579 against total_token_usage 940123: roughly 918k tokens were already in the window before it, which is the CLI's own signal that this turn is not a cold start. There is therefore no anchor to state, so anchor_tokens is absent rather than zero.
